title.en: The Fire Demon in the Wheat

objectives.note: (Jack's example.) A dancing fire demon is burning the crops.
Smoky (never burning-people) fields; cows hiding behind a barn.
Named variant 'Blaze' (fire_elemental); trolls fan the flames.
A rain dance with the farmers.

quests.summary: Defeat Blaze, the dancing fire demon burning Farmer Wang's crops, and his troll helpers.

objectives.note: A young troll kicked his ball into the Beast Pens.
He challenges you to a penalty kick (choice).

quests.summary: Fetch a young troll's soccer ball from the Beast Pens and take his penalty-kick challenge.

objectives.note: The arena coach: 'Beat 8 trolls and you enter the tournament as a seed.'

quests.summary: Win 8 fights against arena trolls to finish Coach Niu's drills.

objectives.note: The fan club's letters for the champion.

quests.summary: Deliver the fan club's letters to the Ogre Champion's manager under the Colosseum.

objectives.note: Animals kept for 'monster shows' need freeing. Vet Ji works at Arena Town outpost 2 (realm_8/town_3), right next to the Beast Pens door portal_2.
The pen keepers, at the dead end past the inn_1 rest stop (quest-gated fight, cond questActive q8_caged_beasts). v3.9: beast_pens_1/miniboss_1 is a campfire inn, so the fight moved here.
Open 3 cages: an elephant, a tiger and a horse run free.

quests.summary: Beat the pen keepers in the Beast Pens and set an elephant, a tiger and a horse free.
